items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Marion Cook, when he was in Chicago playing with the symphony band, he broke his violin and declared he wouldn't play no more

ctx.x: That's George Rickson and Dan Carey and Joe Burrough and his brother Eubie Burrough, they were all Boston men.

Oh, yeah. Marion Cook, when he was in Chicago playing with the symphony band, he broke his violin and declared he wouldn't play no more, see. And when they wanted piano player, he said, I can go to Boston and get all the piano players I want, good piano players, all them piano players were good.
Since you just brought up Will Marion Cook, for the record, tell the people who Will Marion Cook was.
